utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up again. I can check the supply list when I’m out and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the list and bring back whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the tools over in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning works for me. I’ll be there when you bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m a little nervous about the timing and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking, because I want to be sure it’s actually on and not slipping.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring the list, but I left it on the counter. I can still help, though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can swing by after lunch and help sort the list out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, the parts I noticed were the hinges and that loose panel by the garage drive. I might be forgetting something, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, the hinges and the loose panel by the garage drive. Is there anything else you noticed, even if you're not sure?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few things are still needed: someone to sort the tools, and a couple more hands for the last paint and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can sort the tools and help with the paint and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I can help with the repair drive. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll start with the loose porch board by the front steps, then we can move inside if that goes quick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus. I’ll take a look at that porch board first, then we can head inside if there’s time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of that. Where is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the community center on Maple, right after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll note the community center on Maple right after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still collecting names and folks are dropping off supplies all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading over after lunch, and I can bring a box of rags too. Tell Tess I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks, Quinn. I’ll let folks know you’re coming by after lunch with the rags.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m starting at 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive; I’ll repeat the plan to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. If someone asks me, I can send them your plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep repeating it whenever someone asks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll line up the volunteers after this.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send you the finalized list this afternoon, and we can confirm the volunteer assignments then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s been picking up steam lately. Folks around here are really pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yeah, it’s good to see neighbors stepping up. I like knowing there’s a clear list and folks are getting things done.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure seems like people are glad to have a clear system, and it makes it easier for everyone to pitch in where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re just waiting on the last parts and a few hands to finish up. I can go over what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, let me know what parts you still need and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you want me to check something on the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure. I can take a look if you point me to the part that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I need the repair drive locations and the time window, then I can tell you where to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Send me the repair drive locations and the time window, and I’ll head where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that if you tell me what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I just want to make sure I’ve got the details right first. What materials or supplies are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking the list now so I can tell you exactly what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw a note about that, but I may have missed the latest change.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m not sure what changed, but I can check the latest note and let you know if the repair drive moved.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara. I’ll wait for your update before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. Need anything from the hardware store while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m set, thanks. If you spot a decent drill bit set or some heavy-duty screws, grab those and I’ll make use of them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do. I’ll keep an eye out for a solid drill bit set and some heavy-duty screws.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or handle?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring the drill, screwdriver set, and a few spare screws. If you can, handle the outlet cover and check the wiring box.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll bring those and take a look at the outlet cover and wiring box.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know how many people are coming and whether we have enough vans.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people are we expecting, and do we need more vans or not?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should confirm the headcount first; if it’s more than the vans can hold, we’ll need another one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading to the repair drive after lunch, and I’m telling a few neighbors to come by too. Want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Put me down for it, and I can bring a list of what I still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll put you on the list and look for your notes at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, but I’ll need the schedule details first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ve got the schedule somewhere — I’ll dig it up and bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, bring it by when you have it and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready, Nell. Just tell me who you want me to put down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just put me down too, and maybe ask if anyone else on the block still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re on it, Nell. I’ll put you down and ask around for anyone else who still needs a hand.
